LIVE & BREATHE GOODNESS WITH

Kairali Ayurvedic Village – Personalised Wellness Formula

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s flagship ayurvedic destination, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala is one-of-its-kind of a holistic space, which heals you internally and externally with traditional and authentic Ayurvedic therapies, treatments and medications along with Yoga and Meditation. About the Program

Founded in 1989, Kairali embodies a legacy of authentic Ayurveda, with a commitment to spreading its benefits across India and the world. The Advanced Ayurveda Lifestyle Consultant and Therapist Training Program (AALCT-HV) is a practitioner certification course designed for Ayurveda enthusiasts, wellness professionals, and healthcare specialists. This immersive program combines foundational theory, hands-on therapy practice, and expert guidance from Ayurvedic and Yoga professionals at Kairali’s renowned health retreat.

Recommended For

The program is ideally suited to:

Healthcare professionals
Wellness consultants and therapists
Ayurveda enthusiasts seeking advanced expertise

Graduates gain the knowledge and confidence to become recognized Ayurveda experts and practitioners in the wellness sector.

Overview:

AALCT-HV delivers a comprehensive, concise study of Ayurveda, including:

Basic principles and philosophies
Ayurveda therapies and Panchakarma
Dravyaguna (Ayurvedic dietetics)
Prakrithi and body constitution analysis
Ayurvedic approach to managing lifestyle disorders
Home remedies and basics of Ayurveda medicines
Roga Pareeksha & Rogi Pareeksha (diagnosis and patient analysis)

Successful candidates may be considered for Ayurvedic Wellness Consultant roles at Kairali’s international centers and will receive a practitioner certificate.

AALCT-HV students will have the opportunity to engage in projects and hands-on training at our domestic and international centres based on their interests. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village believes that true healing begins with purity, balance, and mindfulness. As part of our commitment to holistic wellness, our retreat is completely alcohol-free and offers a clean and relaxing environment in accordance with the principles of Ayurveda.

Why an Alcohol Free retreat?

Ayurveda, the ancient science of life, emphasizes that what we consume directly affects our physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Alcohol is known to:

Disrupting the body’s detoxification processes
Weakening the digestive fire (Agni) and thereby causing imbalances
To cloud mental clarity, promote fatigue and emotional instability
Impairing the body’s ability to absorb the healing effects of Ayurvedic therapies and herbal applications

By abstaining from alcohol during your stay, your body and mind can experience deep rejuvenation and transformation.

A place for true healing and detoxification

Our resort offers a caring environment where guests can fully focus on their wellness journey. Whether you’re coming for a Panchakarma detox, stress relief, weight loss, or simply to relax, a clean, alcohol-free environment ensures your body receives the best possible regenerative benefits.

Holistic living in Kairali

More than just an alcohol-free zone, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is also a:

Non-smoking area to ensure clean air and a toxic-free atmosphere
Caffeine-free retreat to promote natural energy and mental clarity
Organic vegetarian retreat to support optimal health and digestion
Experience Ayurveda in its purest form

Kairali invites you to live an Ayurvedic lifestyle that benefits your body, mind, and soul. Free yourself from toxins, reset your system, and discover the true power of holistic healing in a tranquil, alcohol-free environment.

HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
Ananda Lahari Retreat Ananda – Happiness Lahari – Wave

In our everyday lives, we encounter and handle numerous situations, whether they involve family, work, relationships, or other obligations. This retreat aims to prepare you to handle life and its circumstances with joy and ease.

By utilizing Ayurveda and the teachings and insights of Yoga, you will achieve harmony and equilibrium between your body and mind, as well as with those around you and your surroundings. These time-honored traditions present ways to improve our contemporary way of living and give you a structure to examine existence and experience life to its maximum potential.

The Ananda Lahari Retreat provides a chance to embark on a genuine and thrilling spiritual adventure in India, fostering a realm abundant with love, light, and joy.

What is the Ananda Lahari Retreat?

The Ananda Lahari Retreat offers a journey to well-being via healing, self-exploration, and transformation of both mind and body. It is ideal for yoga practitioners and instructors at any level seeking to enhance their practice and uncover profound health, wellness, and a connection to their authentic self.

Our authentic complete immersion program lasts 7 days at the stunning Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Kerala. Throughout a week, you will immerse yourself in the complete experience of yogic living: engaging in sunrise meditations and asana practice, participating in discussions on Vedanta and philosophy, practicing yoga nidra, exploring Sanskrit and tantra rituals, along with following an Ayurvedic diet and enjoying daily massages and treatments, you will thoroughly incorporate the yogic lifestyle into your life.

This personal journey will allow you to delve into historical wisdom and traditions and subsequently weave their usage into your everyday life. It is probably one of the most impactful experiences for the future health and wellness of your mind, body, and spirit. You will enhance your health and well-being while also enriching your self-awareness and understanding of the universe, building lifelong connections and friendships, and creating numerous lasting memories.

Where will this Journey Take Me?

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village was selected among the top 50 wellness destinations of the world by National Geographic Traveller. The village is situated in Palakkad, just a few kilometres from the world’s biggest mountain pass between Kerala and Tamil Nadu. This award-winning spa and retreat facility is nestled in a luscious landscape of 600 coconut palms.

Time spent at this unique paradise will allow you to experience the authentic healing practices of ancient India while relaxing in the lap of modern holistic luxury.

What Will I Experience?

The term ‘Ayur’ translates to life, while ‘Veda’ refers to knowledge, thus, Ayurveda signifies ‘knowledge of the science of living’.

You will undergo a comprehensive program of genuine Ayurvedic treatments designed to achieve harmony among body, mind, and spirit. A group of Ayurvedic physicians will assess your health and determine the optimal rejuvenation plan for the week. It might be Abhyangam massages (where two therapists rhythmically and simultaneously apply herbal oils) or other targeted therapies like dhaara to achieve optimal wellness and restore equilibrium in you.

Our sessions on Ayurveda and the visit to Kairali’s Ayurvedic Product Factory will give you a basis for understanding the use of Ayurveda in contemporary life.

Yoga & Meditation

The term Yoga comes from the Sanskrit word yuj, signifying “to join” or “to unite.” It is the harmony of the body, mind, and spirit, as well as the link between the personal self and awareness.

Kairali is an ideal destination for those looking to explore the depths of yoga, its historical context, foundational principles, and relevance in contemporary life. The retreat will include workshops for all levels, encompassing yoga philosophy, vedanta, sanskrit, tantra, and meditation. By consciously incorporating these principles into our lives, we can adopt a unified strategy to create a lifestyle that fosters genuine health and longevity.

The philosophy and wisdom of yoga, which is over 5,000 years old, is extensive. In our workshops, we will assist you in understanding ancient philosophies and incorporating them into your daily life.

Broaden your understanding of Vedanta, yogic philosophy, kundalini, meditation, Sanskrit, and tantra.

Every workshop will involve a free discussion and examination of ideas, along with actionable advice for applying them in your daily life, allowing you to incorporate yoga more completely into your routine.

What will you indulge in during the day?

A typical day would involve:

◆
Sunrise meditation.
◆
Dina Chayra – Morning Ayurvedic rituals cultivate well-being and prepare for the day.
◆
Patanjali Smaran –A guided practice of expressing gratitude to the forefathers of the Yoga tradition in the form of a yagna.
◆
A Vinyasa yoga flow designed to move every muscle in the body.
◆
Yogic breakfast.
◆
Ayurvedic consultation with massage or treatment, i.e., an abhyanga massage designed to detoxify the body. The doctors decide on the oils to be used. They are always medicinal oils extracted from herbs and have immense health benefits.
◆
Yogic lunch
◆
Self Time

A workshop on the authentic texts of Yoga
◆
Rejuv Yoga – A signature yoga flow aimed at rejuvenating the nadis.
◆
Dusk Prayer

Group Dinner

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a model for holistic and sustainable living, not just a wellness resort. This eco-friendly retreat’s Animal Husbandry Program is one of its distinctive features; it is a prime example of a coexisting interaction between people, animals, and the environment. The ethical and sustainable treatment of animals is emphasized in this project, which is in line with Ayurveda’s philosophy of living in harmony with nature.

History of Animal Husbandry

According to Ayurveda, animals are essential to the ecosystem and help to keep the environment in balance. This idea is incorporated into Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village by encouraging a humane and environmentally friendly method of animal husbandry. The initiative helps the local ecology in addition to promoting wellness and agricultural practices at the retreat. Care, respect, and sustainability are the cornerstones of the retreat’s animal husbandry methods. The retreat’s overall sustainability is enhanced while the animals’ well-being is guaranteed by the loving care and natural, healthy surroundings they get.

A Unique Learning Opportunity for Guests

Visitors to Kairali- The Ayurvedic Healing Village can observe how animal husbandry is incorporated into the healing ecosystem of the retreat. Insights into how these techniques enhance the overall sustainability and caliber of the retreat’s activities are provided through interactive seminars and guided tours. It’s an opportunity to discover how health, agriculture, and the environment can all benefit from ethical animal care.

A Commitment to Sustainability and Wellness

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s Animal Husbandry Program is a brilliant representation of how conventional knowledge may coexist with contemporary sustainable techniques. Kairali sets the standard for ethical and environmentally conscious living by carefully caring for animals and incorporating their contributions into the retreat’s wellness ecology.

Up until recently, Ayurveda—The Science of Life—was hidden away in our ancient texts. Except for the “remedies” that our grandmothers frequently used and which performed miracles, most people had nearly forgotten its profound benefits. With the exception of a few individuals who have worked tirelessly to preserve the discipline and have, to some degree, been successful in establishing Ayurveda as an alternative form of treatment, many of us were unaware that it was just “Ayurveda.”

For its efforts in this regard, The Kairali Ayurvedic Group deserves recognition. The Group offers you the concept of “Arogya Kendra” to further advance the science, which is certain to rekindle the public’s long-lost interest in Ayurveda. The initiative’s main objective is to spread yoga and Ayurveda throughout the nation and improve and make the earth a healthier place to live.

For Ayurvedic practitioners who are willing to start an Arogya Kendra in their city, this is a once-in-a-lifetime chance. You will be able to combine many Ayurvedic disciplines under the notion, including medications, products, therapies, treatments, and procedures. People in your cities will be able to choose Ayurveda and avoid the inconvenience of traveling to different locations thanks to this.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group provides doctors with full support so that the entire exercise is error-free and we can resuscitate our ancient science. Working with Kairali, a well-known brand in the wellness sector, can only increase your credibility. Indeed, you will have the opportunity to work for a cause—the advancement of our ancient science, which sorely needs to take the lead. Participate in the effort to make Ayurveda available to everyone.

HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
Ashtanga Yoga & Ayurveda Retreat

Yoga and Ayurveda form an ideal blend for cleansing both the body and mind, helping individuals recognize what truly matters in life and what does not. India is the birthplace of yoga and the wellspring of devotional and meditative motivation. Doing yoga in a location where countless yogis have shaped their forms is akin to accessing a profound spiritual source.

During these two weeks, we will concentrate on finding our inner tranquility and recognizing our unique rhythm by becoming aware of our pulse and biorhythms, emotions, dreams, and digestion, while also permitting ourselves to tune into the changing patterns of physiological rhythms, thoughts, and feelings.

The unique culinary offerings and the daily Ayurvedic care cater to the requirements of every specific constitution type. Through calming massages and oil therapies, the senses can unwind from daily routines. The daily Yoga and Meditation session, set in a serene environment, encourages you to take a break, focus inward, and reconnect with your true self.

YOGA SCHEDULE

Beginners as well as advanced students are welcome to join the program. We practice every day. The weekly courses run from Saturday (Meet and Greet) until Friday evening.

Movement and breath resemble a dance, a creative journey, leading us to the essence of our existence where we discover tranquility, liberation, and quietude within ourselves and among all the creations around us.

Afternoon classes

The afternoon lesson is split into two subject areas.

First area: Our emphasis will be on Meditation or being still in quiet. Engaging in silence enhances your capacity for self-reflection, allowing you to observe the thoughts, feelings, and wishes that arise without immediately responding to them. Three times weekly, we will conduct a guided meditation focusing on the Heart Chakra, Solar Plexus Chakra, and Root Chakra.

Second area: Pranayama, the formal practice of breath control, serves as the source of our essential life energy. We will concentrate on practicing pranayama exercises, breathing methods, and routines.

Attractions (15 Kms & Below)

Palakkad has evolved as an excellent tourist destination, offering wilderness excursions, cultural tours, ancient sites, and temples. The following places are easily accessible and close to Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village.

ON THIS PAGE
◆
Rock Garden

Padmashree Nekchand Saini, a world-renowned sculptor who also designed India’s first rock garden in Chandigarh, created the Malampuzha Rock Garden. It is a true work of art because the artifacts on display are constructed entirely of waste materials such as granites, stones, broken bangles, melamine dishware, broken tiles, power insulators, and so on. It supports a calm planted garden where you can relax and be captivated by the panoramic magnificence of the park’s surrounding mountain ranges.

Chittur Gurumadam

Chittur Gurumadam, located on the banks of the Sokanasdini River in Thekkegramam near Arikkode, is a memorial to Thunchath Ramanujan Ezhuthachan, the father of the Malayalam language. Ezhuthachan replicated the two major Sanskrit epics, the Ramayana and the Mahabharata, in Malayalam. A Shri chakra, a stylus, wooden slippers, a few antique manuscripts, and some of the idols he adored are displayed here.

Fantasy Park

Fantasy Park, located near Malampuzha Dam in Palakkad, is Kerala’s first amusement park, and it is a fun place for the entire family. There are numerous entertainment alternatives available, including 16D Cine Magic rides, Boomerang Water Ride, Multi Slide, Planetarium, Wave Pool, Para Trooper, Dragon Coaster, Rain Disco, Fanta Tub, Super Splash, Tora Tora, Virtual Waterfall, Pirate Ship, Merry-go-round, and more.

Malampuzha (The Reservoir)

The Malampuzha Reservoir is a popular tourist attraction. It is bordered by lovely gardens, amusement parks, fish-shaped aquariums, and a snake park. Boating, pedal boats, rowing boats, water scooters, motor boats, and fishing are all available for a low cost.

Attractions (Above 50 Kms)

Palakkad, with its diverse natural scenery and man-made wonders, has carved its place into the Kerala tourism landscape. It has become one of the most popular destinations for adventure, trekking, and getting close to nature. People from all over the world are drawn to this place. Apart from the sights found inside and near Palakkad’s borders, there are additional fantastic tourist places to visit if you are willing to venture a bit further into the wilderness.

ON THIS PAGE
◆
Nelliampathy

Nelliyampathy, the ‘Queen of Palakkad Hills’, is a lovely place surrounded by wispy clouds and has a charm all its own. The beauty of this location, which is made up of orange plantations and evergreen forests, will captivate you, making it ideal for a relaxing vacation. The area is famed for its tea and coffee plantations, cardamom plantations, waterfalls, and beautiful weather. It is a small but beautiful hill station that is ideal for trekking, Jeep safaris, and bird and animal watching.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 75 Km

Kalamandalam

Kalamandalam, a world-renowned Kathakali training facility, is based near Cheruthuruthy hamlet. Aside from being a renowned Kathakali centre, it also offers training in other performing arts like Mohiniyattam, Koodiyattam, Thullal, and Nangiarkoothu. Training in voice and percussive instruments is also available here. Kalamandalam, founded in 1930 by Malayalam poet Vallathol Narayana Menon, reflects the simplicity, purity, and ethnic environment in which these arts have flourished over generations.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 70 Km

Thrithala

Thrithala, known for its medieval ruins, is of significant archeological significance. Notable cultural monuments are the ruins of a massive mud fort with a deep laterite moat and the Siva temple. The Kattil Madom Temple, a domed edifice composed of granite slabs on the Pattambi-Guruvayoor route, is a Buddhist monument thought to date from the ninth or tenth centuries. The temple most likely represents the transition from Chola to Pandya architecture.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 75 Km

Attappadi (Mountain Valley)

Attappadi is a large mountain valley located near the headwaters of the Bhavani River, below the Western Ghats’ Nilgiri Hills. Its limits extend from Coimbatore district in Tamil Nadu in the east to Karimba, Pottassery, and Mannarghat in the west, and from the Nilgiris in the north to Palghat taluk in the south. These hills are rich in flora and wildlife, and they greet visitors with a sense of freshness and give you complete serenity and joy.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 80 Km

Silent Valley National Park

Silent Valley National Park is Kerala’s second-largest national park, covering a core area of 236.74 square kilometers. The park is one of the last untouched areas of the South-Western Ghats Mountains. The place is completely silent, even without the chirping of cicadas. Road transportation is only available up to Mukkali, which is 24 kilometers from the park, and the remainder of the journey must be completed by foot.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 80 Km

Guruvayur

Guruvayur is regarded as one of Kerala’s most important pilgrimage sites. Sree Krishna Temple is well-known for its curative qualities and attracts an incredible number of pilgrims each year. It is known as the Dwaraka of the South and is notable for its ‘Thulabharam’ offering, in which devotees are weighed against bananas, sugar, jaggery, and coconuts in proportion to their weight. The annual Guruvayur Festival, held in February-March, begins with an elephant race. The festival is unavoidable. Not to mention the Guruvayur Devaswom Elephant Sanctuary, located barely 3 kilometers from the temple and one of the world’s largest elephant sanatoriums, also known as Punnathurkotta.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village:100 Km

Parambikulam Wild Life Sanctuary

Parambikulam Wildlife Sanctuary is a 391-square-kilometre protected area in Chittur Taluk. It is spread throughout Anaimalai Hills and Nelliampathy Hills. The Kerala Parambikulam National Park is covered in bamboo, rosewood, and sandalwood trees, and it is home to a diverse range of animals such as leopards, wild dogs, sloths, crocodiles, civets, tigers, elephants, wild boar, barking deer, spotted deer, monkeys, langurs, porcupines, and macaques.

Attractions – 10 Kms & Under

Kerala provides a pure and authentic experience with Ayurveda. And this is only the start of a great journey!! Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located in the beautiful town of Palakkad, which has an unending number of tourist attractions with a cultural, historical, and religious value that would astound any traveler.

ON THIS PAGE
◆
Thiruvalathoor

Thiruvalathoor is known for its ancient temple, which features excellent woodwork and stone sculptures. According to legend, an army of Gods built the temple’s outside wall, but because they were unable to finish it by daylight, they left it unfinished so that humanity would not notice it. Despite continuous human efforts to erect the wall, it remains unfinished.

Thenari

Thenari is a holy shrine located on the Pollachi Road from Palakkad town. The famed Sree Rama temple in Thenari is devoted to Lord Rama, and the natural spring in front of the old temple is revered as sacred as the waters of the holy Ganges. It is claimed that Lord Rama and Sita visited this location during their exile.

Jain Temple of Jainimedu

Jainimedu is a Jain temple located 3 kilometres from Palakkad’s centre. It was built in the 15th century. This temple was built by Jain Leader Inchana Satur and is dedicated to Chandraprabha, a Tirthankar of the Jain religion. This granite marvel of history is 32 feet long and 20 feet wide, with images of the Jain Thirthankaras and Yakshinis. Kumaranasan, a highly regarded Malayalam poet, penned his famous poem Veenapoovu (The Fallen Flower) at a Jain residence near this temple.

Tipu’s Fort

Tipu’s Fort, also known as the Palakkad Fort, stands high in the middle of Palakkad. Hyder Ali, the monarch of the Mysore region, built this fort in 1766, and it is now a protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India. The fort has an open-air auditorium called “Rappadi” on its vast grounds. Inside, there is a little temple called Anjaneya Swamy Temple, and on the opposite side is a children’s park. It is one of the best-preserved forts in southern India.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 14 Km

Kalpathy Shiva Temple

Kalpathy is one of Kerala’s oldest ‘Brahmin Agraharams’, situated in the heart of the town. The ‘Ratholsavam’ event, which takes place in the middle of November, is well-known in Palakkad.

Each package is customized to meet your specific health needs, providing a transforming experience through Ayurveda, and holistic wellness in Kerala’s tranquil settings.
